body: Accepted request7f1c2378. Exact planned API checkpoint (source implementation next, not compiled): @MainActor DocumentWorkspace.editInLayers(_ item: PhotoItem?, completion: @escaping @MainActor (DocumentLoadOutcome) -> Void = { _ in }). DocumentLoadOutcome: installed, rejected(String), failed(String), workspaceReleased. Existing void call sites stay source compatible via default callback. Completion is exactly once after openDocumentFromImage/openDocument returns and installation or orphan cleanup settles; early rejected inputs settle synchronously. A must capture reservation strongly in completion and release for every outcome, not at dispatch. No cancellation API or global SaveGate coupling in this small slice. Source will be a separate commit atop codex/document-save-settlement; tests UNRUN. B hold unchanged.
